culture-cycles.note: State holidays only; the nine nationwide holidays (in 2027: 1 Jan, 26 and 29 Mar, 1 May, 6 and 17 May, 3 Oct, 25 and 26 Dec) are on Germany's record. Several 2027 dates fall on a weekend, and there is no substitute weekday.

laws.rule: Hamburg charges a culture and tourism tax (Kultur- und Tourismustaxe) on every paid overnight stay, graded by the net room price per person; breakfast and other extras are not taxed. The host owes it and may pass it on to guests.

items.text: Hamburg fines: consuming in front of minors €1,000 (about A$1,589); within 100 m of schools, kindergartens, playgrounds, youth facilities or public sports grounds €500 (about A$795); in pedestrian zones 7 am to 8 pm €500; carrying 26 to 30 g away from home €500 to €1,000.
